audience: school administrators and office staff who manage students, rolls and attendance in Orah

useCases.title: Check who is on grounds and where
useCases.text: List the school's location tree, then read the current location of each student.

useCases.title: Review roll marks for one lesson
useCases.text: List the completed rolls in a time range, then read one roll with each student's mark and reason.

useCases.title: Check daily attendance for a date window
useCases.text: List each student's daily attendance status for a date window of up to 12 months.

useCases.title: Find a student and the contacts to call
useCases.text: Filter students by house or year level, then list the contacts of one student.

useCases.title: Add a student and a guardian contact
useCases.text: Create a student record, then add the parent or guardian contact for that student. This writes to the school's live Orah.
